请在我提供的 Cove 示例项目中开发插件。先阅读 manifest.json、:
Develop a plugin in this Cove example project. Read manifest.json, plugin.py, README-dev.md and sdk/plugin-manifest.schema.json before editing.
Requirements:
- Name: [plugin name]
- id: [community.my-tool; independent and stable]
- Problem: [real use case]
- Inputs: [names, types, required fields and defaults]
- Results: [expected data]
- Operations: [identify read-only operations and changes to external state]
Constraints:
1. Keep Tool(Plugin) and public command contracts. Write logic in Python without custom HTML/JS/CSS.
2. Align manifest.commands, ui.actions, field ids, ai.tools.command and method signatures.
3. Provide complete JSON Schema with additionalProperties:false; use readOnly:false for state changes.
4. Keep credentials out of defaults, logs, results and source. Write user data to self.context.data_dir.
5. Build and verify a minimal working version first. Never fabricate execution, tool results or compatibility.
6. Report changed files, executed commands and unfinished verification.
控制范围，比一次生成很多代码更可靠。: A narrow scope makes verification easier.
先只完成一个主命令。列出输入、输出和失败条件，然后实现 manifest.jso: Implement one main command first. List inputs, outputs and failure cases, then implement manifest.json and plugin.py. Reuse dev.py and package.py. Declare dependencies in requirements.txt without installing untrusted programs. Run python dev.py and explain its real result. Fix errors without bypassing manifest validation or substituting fixed success strings for functionality.

用失败场景检验，而不只点一次成功。: Test failure cases as well as success.
请对当前插件做实际验收：1. 正常输入得到期望结果；2. 空值、非法格式、超长值: Verify this plugin by running it: 1. Valid input returns the expected result. 2. Empty, malformed, oversized or missing inputs give clear errors. 3. Manifest commands match methods. 4. Results support json.dumps. 5. close() releases resources. 6. Logs and results contain no credentials. Run dev.py and report actual commands, exit codes and results. Fix failures and rerun affected checks. Use isolated local resources for host access and external writes; never fabricate remote verification.
核对错误是否指向真实输入，而不是被 try/except 吞掉。涉及网络的功能还: Check that errors identify the actual input rather than being swallowed by try/except. Network functions also need timeout and cancellation checks.
请为当前插件的适合自动化的命令补齐 ai.tools。用同一个 Python 方: Declare ai.tools for commands suitable for automation, reusing the same Python methods. Mark queries readOnly:true and state changes false, with explicit parameter schemas. Run python package.py and inspect .cove-plugin and -dsh.zip for excluded SDK files, virtual environments, user data and credentials. Extract the DSH package in a clean folder, install requirements.txt, run setup_dsh.py and inspect the official dsh-mcp-client overlay. Complete initialize, tools/list and a real tools/call with an MCP client. Standalone mode exposes read-only tools; writes use Cove's one-time approval. If DSH is unavailable, state that session integration remains unverified.

Document installation, sample inputs, dependencies, permissions and troubleshooting. 5. Report Cove GUI, MCP and DSH verification separately. 6. Check source and artifacts for passwords, keys, personal paths and user data. Keep temporary test output out of releases. Report the project folder, absolute paths to both artifacts and anything still unverified.
